settings.anchor_selection: Known robust development geometry; historical outcomes are not reused as new labels
settings.learning: Context=[boardH,tilt]; continuous ACTION=release gap only; each shot terminal; no next-state bootstrap

objectives.adaptive_surrogate: Supervised binary capture probability, uncalibrated; adaptive acquisition also uses shaped reward
objectives.sac: Terminal shaped reward plus normalized-action entropy
objectives.evaluation: Both ranked by held-out capture counts; no claim of identical training objectives

settings.uniform: One frozen independent bounded-uniform base gap per test context (8 actions); repeat each3 nominal +20 paired gap-noise trials; no feasible-action oracle or resampling

adaptive.method: Refine observed transitions plus broad uncertain intervals; preserve disconnected sampled hit runs

settings.selection: Max validation captures, then mean shaped reward, then earliest milestone; test never selects/retrains
settings.evaluation: Frozen mean SAC action or frozen129-gap surrogate prediction grid; no native outcome search, projection, retry or resampling at inference

noise.scope: Gap-only perturbations; exact board context/joint branch fixed; out-of-bounds requests fail

settings.gate_scope: All requests use frozen board branch and strict endpoint checks; common-start paths checked separately for selected control/recipes; no actuator-tracking claim
settings.reward: Unchanged sircus.mjlab.learning_contract.reward; success is board rebound + whole-ball entry + continuous1s retention
settings.scope: Fixed bucket and board XY; held-posture simulation. Tests generalize across held-out boardH/tilt contexts, not bucket positions, perception or arm trajectories.

physics.arm_control: Prescribed joint endpoints reset before each native step; no learned grasp/transit/actuator dynamics
physics.scorer: Unchanged board rebound + whole sphere entry + continuous1s retention; external assistance disqualifies route; bucket rim assistance counts
